attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own newsletter post, stated in his voice. He is not quoting anyone else.

semantics.note: Verbatim, and the 'estimated' qualifier is kept. The cost part is a checkable observation. 'Deeply unsustainable' is his evaluative judgment, which the contract rightly leaves unscored. Any published verdict covers only the estimate.

contract.note: The result depends on reading 'estimated' as whether a credible estimate in that range was in circulation before the post. That reading comes from his own word and is the ordinary one. The $100k–$999k band is a fair reading of 'hundreds of thousands'. Leaving the judgment unscored is fair.

evidence.note: TechSpot, 24 Apr 2023, reports SemiAnalysis's estimate of about $694,444 a day for ChatGPT. That is before the post, in USD per day, and within the band.

PC Gamer, 9 May 2023, reports $700k–$1M a day. This is a second pre-post report of the same estimate. The low end is within the band. Sidebar links on the retrieved page don't affect the cited passage.
Estimated 2022 OpenAI net loss of about $540M. This is a different metric and period. It bears only on the unscored 'unsustainable' judgment.

reviews.rationale: Two independent 2023 news reports, both before the 20 Nov 2023 post, give SemiAnalysis's estimate of about $694k–$1M a day for running ChatGPT. That meets the support condition for an estimate in the hundreds of thousands. The packet shows no contrary estimate. 'Deeply unsustainable' is an opinion and is not scored, so the verdict covers only the estimate.
